cohort: 674 nulliparous women with and without uterine anomalies delivering a live birth at Kaiser Permanente Northern California between 2009-2016.
finding: Women with uterine anomalies had a significantly increased risk of preterm birth (<37 and <34 weeks), PPROM, cesarean delivery, and malpresentation compared to women without uterine anomalies.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was higher in women with uterine anomalies (OR 3.0; 95% CI 2.2-4.2; p<0.01).
